text: Hey Totoro!
We're finally back on Fuller Road in Dhaka Valley, aren't we?
*Rumble-purr!* [Sniffs happily]
The warm scent of Krishnachura blossoms, clay-cup cha, and crispy Naga fuchka!
We first met right under the Curzon Hall red-brick verandas, remember?
Every single memory we forged together here anchors reality itself!
*Nods with giant smile*
From clay cups at TSC to cycle rickshaw bells, every second with you is eternal!
Look! Ahead on the street is the Tong-er Mama stall.
Let's get five cups of malai cha and two plates of fuchka!
*Licks lips excitedly*
Alright, let's head down Fuller Road!
Hey little spirit! Keep up! Who left that parked rickshaw in the middle of the road?
*Squeak-squeak!* [Bouncing on tires]
Hey! Get that little creature off my rickshaw tires NOW!
Who told you kids you could walk through our street?
Take it easy, buddy! We're just students enjoying an afternoon date walk.
Well, well, well! Look what wandered past Fuller Road.
Moon Walker and a giant walking fur-ball!
Hand over your Dhaka Cyber Arcade tokens and that giant mascot, little girl!
*ROAAAAR!* [Rumbles angrily]
Take one step back! Moon Walker has more kindness, grace, and courage than all of you combined!
Back off, Arkian!
Your days of bullying students and disturbing Dhaka Valley are OVER!
Are they over, Moon Walker?
Boys, surround that giant spirit and grab the tokens! Teach this girl a lesson!
